definitions.gloss: passionate singing; singing with intense emotion
definitions.explanation: Singing with great passion and emotional intensity. Often used to describe powerful vocal performances at concerts, karaoke, or on music programs.

examples.japanese: カラオケで{熱唱|ねっしょう}する。
{彼女|かのじょ}はバラードを{熱唱|ねっしょう}した。
examples.english: She sang the ballad with great passion.

examples.japanese: ライブの{最後|さいご}に{代表曲|だいひょうきょく}を{熱唱|ねっしょう}し、{会場|かいじょう}は{大|おお}いに{盛|も}り{上|あ}がった。
examples.english: At the end of the concert, the artist passionately sang their signature song and the venue erupted in excitement.

notes: Composed of {熱|ねつ} (heat, passion) + {唱|しょう} (chant, sing). Describes singing with emotional intensity and passion — not just technical skill. Common collocations: {熱唱|ねっしょう}する (to sing passionately), {熱唱|ねっしょう}を{披露|ひろう}する (to give a passionate singing performance). Frequently used in entertainment news and music show commentary. Part of the {熱〜|ねつ〜} family expressing intensity: {熱演|ねつえん} (impassioned performance), {熱弁|ねつべん} (impassioned speech), {熱戦|ねっせん} (heated match/contest).
